title: Google My Business for Coffee Shops (2020 update) | BrewRound

facts.fact: BrewRound's page states that 46% of all Google searches are for local businesses, with no source cited.
facts.quote: 46% of all Google searches are for local businesses.

facts.fact: BrewRound's page is dated August 29, 2020, and is labelled a 2020 update.
BrewRound says creating a Google My Business listing is free.
facts.quote: Creating a Google My Business listing is free and doesn’t take that long to set up.

facts.fact: According to BrewRound, a Google My Business listing requires a Google account, which can be registered for free.
facts.quote: You will need a Google account to do this. If you don’t already have an account you will be asked to register one for free.

facts.fact: According to BrewRound, Google verifies a business location by mailing a letter containing a code, and the profile does not appear in results until verified.
facts.quote: Google will send you out a letter with a code on it.

facts.fact: According to BrewRound, a business can select only one category when creating a listing, and more can be added later.
facts.quote: At this stage, you can select one although more can be added later in the process.

facts.fact: BrewRound describes the Google My Business Offer post as accepting a photo, title, start and end dates, details, T&Cs, a voucher code, and a redemption link.
facts.quote: You can upload a photo, offer title, start date, end date, offer details, T&Cs, voucher code and a link to redeem.
